title: PyTorch for Deep Learning
summary: PyTorch tensors, neural networks, and training pipelines, followed by transfer learning and advanced architectures. Model optimization, compression, and deployment using tools such as ONNX and MLflow.

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning: From Theory to Practice
summary: Neural function approximation, DQN and its stabilizing techniques, policy gradients, and actor–critic methods. Implementation and evaluation of deep RL agents, including PPO, DDPG, and SAC.

title: Computer Vision
topic: University of Colorado Boulder · Coursera · Specialization
summary: Classical image processing and feature extraction, followed by CNNs for image classification and segmentation. Modern vision and multimodal models, including Vision Transformers, CLIP, and diffusion models.

title: Vision Language Model Bootcamp
summary: Multimodal embeddings and zero-shot image classification with CLIP. Hands-on image captioning and zero-shot object detection using Qwen2.5-VL.
